races.title: CopyBet For Champions League Profit Boosts Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: BARBURY BOY found only an odds-on favourite too strong on his hurdling debut at Plumpton recently so, with improvement on the cards, Alan King's charge gets the vote to go one better. The penalised Thisonesforyou looks an obvious threat having made the perfect start for new connections earlier in the month, with Aukus and Pantile's Gift taken to fight out minor honours. BARBURY BOY THISONESFORYOU AUKUS (IRE)

races.title: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

DANCE AND GLANCE BOND BROKER (IRE) CINQUENTA (FR)

races.title: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A tricky betting race with a few likely to have one eye on the Pertemps Final itself. ROAD TO WEMBLEY has enjoyed a fine year over hurdles and may be rewarded with a fourth victory. Ernest Gray could make a bold bid to defy a career-high mark, with East India Express very much respected given his record around here. ROAD TO WEMBLEY ERNEST GRAY (IRE) EAST INDIA EXPRESS (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Ernest Gray (9/4), East India Express (11/4), Idaho Fire (5/1), Ikarak (11/2), Road To Wembley (11/2), Marsiac (12/1)
